asked.item: Am I in the wrong place (Plugins > MCPs > Add MCP server)?
Form asks for a command to launch and arguments, but I only have an address

verdict.reason: The ChatGPT desktop app section describes this same form, says it opens on STDIO, and says to select Streamable HTTP and enter the URL.

steps.text: You are in the right place: in the ChatGPT desktop app, you open Plugins, then MCPs, then click Add, then Add MCP server.
The form opens on STDIO, so select Streamable HTTP instead.
Under Headers, set blotato-api-key to your full API key, and leave Bearer token env var blank.
Save and restart the MCP connection or client.
